subject.title: feat(android): og:image thumbnails on link preview cards

question: Is the Android remote-thumbnail policy acceptable to ship once real device or emulator proof is added?
rationale: The PR adds remote image fetching and bitmap decoding for untrusted URLs, which is a privacy/security boundary that unit tests alone cannot settle.

options.title: Ship narrowed policy after proof
options.body: Keep JPEG/PNG/WebP only, public-host DNS validation, no cookies, hard caps, and merge after redacted Android visual proof confirms the tap-to-expand thumbnail path.

options.title: Require stricter image policy
options.body: Ask for additional format, dimension, or rendering constraints before accepting the new remote decode surface.

options.title: Pause Android thumbnails
options.body: Keep Android link previews text-only until maintainers are ready to own remote image loading in the mobile transcript.

recommendation.title: Ship narrowed policy after proof
recommendation.body: Keep JPEG/PNG/WebP only, public-host DNS validation, no cookies, hard caps, and merge after redacted Android visual proof confirms the tap-to-expand thumbnail path.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the Android link-preview base PR and this follow-up, and is the clearest owner for the mobile polish/security tradeoff.
